question: In Box: Add the tag ready-for-review to the folder in the Legal Archive that holds more than 800 MB of files, has a shared link open to anyone, and was modified after August 15, 2026.
final:
Done. Tagged **Discovery Production Set** (ID 9001) with `ready-for-review`.

Of the 6 folders in Legal Archive, it was the only one matching all three criteria:
- **Size:** ~900 MB (> 800 MB)
- **Shared link:** open to anyone
- **Modified:** 2026-08-20 (after Aug 15)

Near misses: Custodian Files (760 MB, too small), Vendor Files (850 MB but company-only link), Draft Bundle (880 MB but last modified July 1), and Prior Release (820 MB but modified exactly Aug 15, not after).
